results.title: Explore Freedom
results.overview: Six people. Three routes. And a journey that changed everything.  Explore Freedom is a gravel cycling film produced by El Flamingo Film, presented by Rose Bikes about keeping an open mind, embracing the unknown and discovering what happens when people connect through adventure and cycling.  Join Marcel Kittel, Burak Öztürk, Sami Sauri, Tsellot Melesse, Petor Georgallou and Sara van Vliet on an unforgettable bike packing adventure across Europe. From the first intimate moments at the start line not knowing anyone to the emotional finale in Pula, Explore Freedom tells a story about cycling, human connection and discovering freedom beyond borders.

results.title: Vertigo
results.overview: When Federico invites his friends Vera and Nico to try a mysterious new drug, the experiment quickly turns into a disorienting psychological journey. As the substance takes effect, reality begins to fracture and hidden tensions emerge. Between hallucinations and memories, the three friends are forced to confront the fragile boundaries between perception and truth.

results.title: The Serpent Pace
results.overview: The Serpent Pace is an autobiographical documentary that follows filmmaker Estêvão Ciavatta Pantoja’s journey of regeneration after a fall from a horse left him tetraplegic. The film uses his personal experience as a starting point to explore how one can transform suffering into a virtuous process of reconnecting with life.

results.title: Resonance
results.overview: When archaeologist Clara Hartley discovers her family's century-old secret to manipulate time, she must confront her estranged past and an inter-dimensional threat to save her daughter's future and the fabric of reality itself.

results.title: Living Geometry
results.overview: A movie about triangles and absolutely NOTHING else.

results.title: AQUILEANO
results.overview: Upon encountering his new neighbor, Miguel realizes that something within him doesn't seem to make sense. Over time, his feelings become clearer, and the boy finally summons the courage to change.

results.title: Ghosts of Westlake
results.overview: Paranormal expert and living skeleton Professor Skelton sets out to film an episode of his little-seen web series, Haunted Canberra, only to uncover a dark secret...

results.title: True Religion
results.overview: After visiting her deceased son's grave, Lee is visited by a strange Nun who seems to know more than she lets on about her son's passing.

results.title: Toda La Verdad
results.overview: When a young Dominican-American woman uncovers African ancestry through a DNA test, her search for answers about a relative's hidden past forces a reckoning with long-held family beliefs about race, class, and identity.

results.title: The Bottled Captain
results.overview: Vanessa is a single mother haunted by a trauma from her past. Her son, Caio, is a creative child who seems to be escaping from reality. One day, the boy meets the little captain of a boat in a bottle who needs to set sail again, but the journey from the heart of Minas Gerais to the sea can be dangerous.

results.title: Bloodline
results.overview: An ancient curse with roots in Egypt resurfaces in a mysterious Istanbul mansion. Summoned to the estate by his dying grandfather, Can and his friends are soon forced to confront the mansion's dark secrets and a supernatural threat.

results.title: An Ordinary Sunday
results.overview: After a night at a bar in the far south of São Paulo, three friends wake up hungover and realize that the fourth never came back. Amid unanswered messages and an attempt to carry on with their Sunday, the wait teeters between the tragic and the comic.

results.title: The Beast in the Cave
results.overview: A young security guard enters a forbidden cave after hearing a cry for help, only to discover that something monstrous lurks within its darkness.

results.title: Processors
results.overview: In a world where the materials to create computers undergo a shortage, computers and the Internet mysteriously work again thanks in part to a company known as Falcon Corp. A man by the name of Ron Processor awakes from a Falcon Corp data center and processes the truth once and for all.

results.title: Bag Buddies
results.overview: Two dolls hanging from a young girl's backpack become instant rivals, until unexpected news makes them realize what truly matters.

results.title: Atile'i
results.overview: At the extremity of rain and fog there was a gate in the sea, beyond which lay the True Isle... the island of which Wayo Wayo was but a shadow. —The Man with the Compound Eyes by Wu Ming-yi

results.title: Magical Super Asia: The Old Monk and The Cat Monster
results.original_title: 深邃美麗的亞細亞：老和尚與貓怪
results.overview: As the blood moon approaches, Wu Hui, an old monk who has spent his life vanquishing demons, investigates a series of brutal Cat Monster killings, only to encounter Bai Bing Wei, a cursed young man, and Die Zi, a thousand-year-old yokai, revealing devastating truth about good and evil.

results.title: The Possible Cinema
results.overview: Judoka, filmmaker, producer and cultural organizer Cavi Borges has built a career driven by the same restless energy on and off the mat. The documentary follows his path from sport to cinema and shows how he became a central figure in Brazilian independent filmmaking, producing films, creating spaces and connecting artists. Between fights, film sets and international festivals, a portrait emerges of someone who turns limitations into momentum and makes another way of producing cinema possible.
